en:
She had real talent, that one. But I guess it just wasn't in
the cards for her.

To survive in this business, talent's key, of course, but a
lot of it just boils down to luck.
Luck?

Indeed. Not everybody gets the same chances, ya know? That's
where the "luck" part comes into play.

And for some, no matter how talented they may be, that lucky
chance just never comes. That's the cold, hard truth of it.

So for those lucky ones whose chance comes for them, they
have to be sure reach out and grab it.

Until then, it's a matter of pourin' everything you have
into your work and just believing that, someday, your chance
will come.

Polishin' our skills for that chance at the stage, that's
what our work's all about.

As a matter of fact, it's not just our work. I think the
same applies to all kinds of jobs, maybe even life itself.
Nomu-san...

But what am I ramblin' on about? Haha, sorry. Got kinda
serious, there, didn't it? Never mind me.

But I do wanna say that the Princess League is your big
chance, Haruka-chan. Be sure to grab it, ya hear?

Think of all those poor people whose chance will never come,
and give it your all!
Well, I guess I'll be on my way.

(Wow. He may make some inappropriate jokes on air, but off
stage, he's a much deeper and more caring person than you'd
think.)

(So I remind him of Park-san when she was young? If I won
the Princess League... I wonder if she'd be proud of me.)

(Someone wants to have a dance battle with me? I wonder what
they're like. I'm actually a little nervous.)

(But it's Akari's friend, and I do want a chance to try to
make it up to Akari for the other day.)

(So, the Sotenbori Footpath, somewhere behind Zuboraya near
the trees. Got it! I'll go check it out.)
(Oh! An email from Akari!)
No way... Maki lost?

Whew! You're good. I know I'm not back at the top of my game
yet, but I still can't believe you beat me at hip-hop.
*pant* *pant* Thank you.

No wonder you're doing so great on the Princess League! This
is an entirely different genre, but you have all the basics
down. I really underestimated you.

Well, you got me this time, but next time we dance,
things'll be different!

I'll be all healed up and in top form. Then we'll see what
happens!
I guess we will.

Thanks for doing this today. Anyway, I guess I'll be seeing
you. All right, you two! Let's go!

(Phew. I pulled it off, but it wasn't easy. Hip-hop is
tough!)
Oh, Akari! Did you see the battle just now?

I did. Haruka, you're just incredible. I can't believe you
actually beat Maki. You really have talent, you know that?
But you're really talented too, Akari!
(I have to apologize to her for what happened.)

Akari, I've been wanting to talk to you about last time. I'm
really so⑬
I'm so sorry, Haruka!

About last time, about my attitude. I'm really sorry! You
and Christina didn't do anything wrong. It was all my fault.
I was just about to apologize to you! I'm sorry, Akari.

I've felt so bad ever since it happened. I've been thinking
about you this whole time, but I was too scared to call you.

What a terrible friend I've been, not even trying to talk to
you when I knew how much you were hurting. I'm so sorry,
Akari!

I've felt the same way. I've been wanting to apologize to
you this whole time, too, but I was just too afraid. Some
friend, huh?
Akari... Hey, have you been keeping up with your dancing?

Yeah, sure. You know. Dance is just about the only thing I
have going for me.
Well, I'm really glad to hear it.

Hey, enough about all that. Let's just go back to being
friends, yeah?
Hehe... Yeah!

Heheh. Well, now that we've made up, what do you say we go
get something to eat. My treat!
Are you sure? That sounds great!
Okay, let me just go grab my things. I'll be right back.
Huh? Haruka-chan?
Oh! Yui-chan!

It's been a while. I think the last time we saw each other
was at school when we ate lunch together.

I think you're right. I haven't even gotten any emails from
you lately. I've missed you.

Sorry about that. I just figured you were busy with work and
didn't want to bother you, you know?
I'm back⑬ Oh!

Akari, let me introduce you. This is Yui Namiki. She goes to
our school, too.

Being a transfer student, I didn't have any friends at
first, but Yui-chan went out of her way to be nice and talk
to me.
Sure! Yui and I already know each other!

Yup! Akari-chan and I live really close, so we always see
each other on the way to and from school. That's how we
became friends.

But I didn't know the two of you were friends. What are you
guys up to right now?

We were just about to go get something to eat. Want to come
with us?
Really? You don't mind?
Of course we wouldn't mind! Let's go together, all three of us!
Yeah, okay!
Great, then! Hey, what do you two say to okonomiyaki?
*pant* *pant* You win.

*pant* *pant* Yeah, but you were pretty great, yourself.
This wasn't even your genre.

Well, if you ever want a rematch, I'll be here anytime. Just
let me know!

(Let's see. The person who wanted to have a dance battle
with me should be around here somewhere.)
Are you Haruka Sawamura, that idol everybody's talking about?

Well, yes, I'm Haruka Sawamura, but I don't know about the
"everybody's talking about" part.

As if. You're the talk of the town around here. Didn't you
know?

We keep hearing about this idol dancer who's on the Princess
League, and how she's been taking down the dancers around
here one by one.
Oh, really? Sorry about that.

Hmph. You don't have to apologize. The dancers who lost to
you are the ones to blame, right?

I got a message that someone wanted to have a dance battle
with me...

Oh, right. Yeah, that would be me. I wanted to see if all of
these rumors were true.
I'm Maki, the leader of a dance group called the Hipsters.
I really hope you'll accept my challenge.
The genre is hip-hop.
Hip-hop?

Yeah, I don't suppose you do much hip-hop, being an idol and
all, but that's the only kind of dance I do. I'm injured
right now, too.

I won't be able to give one hundred percent, so I guess that
that'll make us about even. What do you say? Wanna take me
on?

(Someone else wants to have a dance battle with me? I wonder
who it'll be this time?)

(It says they'll be waiting near the entrance to the
Bunzaemon Outdoor Mall. Okay, let's go see.)
*pant* *pant* Are... Are you for real?
I can't believe Aya-san lost!
Wow, Haruka! You did it!

Well, I gave you a handicap, but you would've beat me
anyway. With all that talent, who can blame you for lording
over people a little?
I most certainly do not lord it over people!

Hehe. I was just teasing. You know, something tells me we'll
be having another battle someday. No handicap next time,
though, okay?

(Phew! I managed to pull it off again somehow. There's a lot
more to house dancing than meets the eye!)

Unbelievable. First, Maki, and now Aya! You've got some
amazing talent, girl!
Oh, I don't know about that. It was probably just a fluke.

I'm sorry I keep asking you to come out here like this. I
know you're busy. It's just there are more and more girls
who want to battle you!

Usually I just tell them no, but when first-rate dancers
like Maki and Aya ask, it's pretty hard to turn them down.

No, that's okay. Besides, I learn a lot from battling such
talented opponents!

You mean it? Well, it's a relief to hear you say that! Oh,
by the way, are you free at all right now?
Sure, I have time.
Yui and I are planning on going shopping. Want to come with?
Shopping? I'd love to!
Great! I'll call Yui, then!

*pant* *pant* You weren't bad, yourself. But you know, I'm
not really all that satisfied.

Tell you what. I'll be here anytime if you ever want to
battle again. Next time, I hope you'll give me even more of
a challenge.
Hey, Akari.
So you're Sawamura-san?

I had Akari invite you here for me. I'm Aya, of a dance group
called the House Queens. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you, too!

I've heard all about you. I even hear you've been lording it
over people ever since you beat Maki.
I haven't been lording it over people!

That's right! Haruka wouldn't do that. What a terrible thing
to say, Aya!

Well, never mind. It doesn't really matter to me either way.
I'll just get straight to the point.
I want to have a dance battle with you. The genre is house.
House?

Yup. It's what I do. But I bet it isn't your best genre, so
I'll give you a handicap. How about it? You in?

Phew! We must've gone to a thousand shops! But we still
didn't end up buying anything, did we?

The prices were kind of high for a poor student like me.
I'll have to wait for a sale.

What about you, Haruka? You work and make money. I bet you
can buy any clothes you want, huh?

Huh? Oh, no, I'm still just a newbie when it comes to my
job. Besides, I don't really care that much about clothes.

I can attest to that. I think I've only ever seen you in the
same two or three outfits!
Ouch! I'm afraid you might be right, though...

Hehe. Hey, do you guys mind if we stop by Don Quijote for a
minute?
Sounds good to me. Let's go!
Well, should we go home, then?
I guess... Wait a minute! I have an idea.

Seeing how we're all together, why don't we go to a
PrintCircle?
PrintCircle?

Great idea! I haven't done that in a while. What do you say,
Haruka-chan?

(Another person who wants to have a dance battle? I wonder
who it is this time.)

(She's supposed to be waiting in the South Shofukucho
parking lot. I'll go check it out.)
(An email. I wonder who it's from.)
Huh? Did Judy-san really just lose?
Heh. Now I see why Christina thinks so much of you.
You know Christina-san?

Of course! There's hardly a single person in the dancing
world who doesn't know who Christina is!

I don't like him very much, myself. I mean, how can anybody
trust the guy's judgment if he can't even appreciate how
good Akari is?

Akari's my friend, you know. So maybe she's not the most
flamboyant dancer, but she's precise and she looks good
doing it.

She has a solid foundation, so if she'd just come out of her
shell a little more, she'd be a great dancer. That's what I
thought, anyway.

But now she's gone and quit dancing. It's a real shame.
It really, really is.
What!? Akari quit dancing!?

Yeah. Aren't you two supposed to be friends? You mean you
didn't know?
She told me she was still dancing...

Knowing Akari, she probably didn't tell you the truth
'cause she didn't want you to feel guilty.

After all, you can't say you're completely unrelated to the
reason she quit, right? You know what I'm talking about.
I do. I'd better go talk to her face-to-face.
That sounds good. I mean, you're friends, right?
Oh, and could you give this to her for me?
You got <Color:8>Dance Battle Summit Leaflet<Color:Default>.

It's a leaflet for the Dance Battle Summit. They're holding
it over at the event hall over by Iwao Bridge pretty soon.

I'm going, of course. And Maki and Aya, too. There's gonna
be all kinds of great dancers there.

And, as a special guest, the world-famous choreographer
Mittsu is going to be there, too!

Getting his attention'd be a huge boost to any dancer or
choreographer's career.
A choreographer... That's Akari's dream.

I know. That's why I want you to give her the leaflet. You
will, right?
Of course. Akari is my friend.

Good. You should be able to find her on Iwao Bridge if you
go now.
Okay. I will!

You weren't too bad, but was that really your best? Kind of
a letdown, if I'm being honest, especially since you had a
handicap and everything.

Nope! I'm not satisfied. I want a rematch when you're ready.
I'll be waiting for you, so come back anytime.
Haruka Sawamura, I've been waiting for you.

I'm the leader of the dance group Jazzy Blue. The name's
Judy. I'm the one who sent you that email.

Seeing how you beat Maki and Aya, people might start
thinking I'm chickenshit if I don't go up against you, too.
So let's do this.

The genre is jazz. That's my thing. But it's not yours, I'm
guessing, so I'll give you a handicap.
Jazz...
What do you say? Wanna take me on?

(I wonder if Akari will come? Anyway, I'd better head to the
event hall southeast of Iwao Bridge.)

What a great battle that was! And the winner is... Haruka
Sawamura!

You sure are amazing, Haruka. Like I always say, you have
some real talent.

But you won't beat me again. I love dancing. I'm going to
practice and practice, and the next time we battle, I'm
going to win!
